require "test_helper"

class StalledCardsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as :david
    Current.session = sessions(:david)
    @board = boards(:writebook)
    @card = cards(:buy_domain)
  end

  test "index with indexed_by=stalled lists only accessible stalled cards in HTML and JSON" do
    freeze_time

    @card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))

    inaccessible_card = with_current_user(:kevin) do
      boards(:private).cards.create!(title: "Secret stalled", creator: users(:kevin), status: :published).tap do |card|
        card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))
      end
    end

    other_account_card = cards(:radio)
    with_current_user(:mike) { other_account_card.toggle_assignment(users(:mike)) }

    non_bursted_card = cards(:text)

    travel 15.days

    get cards_path, params: { indexed_by: "stalled" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(non_bursted_card, :article)}", count: 0
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(inaccessible_card, :article)}", count: 0
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(other_account_card, :article)}", count: 0

    get cards_path(format: :json), params: { indexed_by: "stalled" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal [ @card.number ], @response.parsed_body.pluck("number")
    assert_equal [ true ], @response.parsed_body.pluck("stalled")
  end

  test "stalled indicator is shown wherever cards are shown and cleared on activity" do
    logout_and_sign_in_as :kevin
    Current.session = sessions(:kevin)
    freeze_time

    @board.publish
    @card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))
    column_card = cards(:text)
    column_card.toggle_assignment(users(:kevin))

    travel 15.days

    # Card show page
    get card_path(@card)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    # Card show JSON
    get card_path(@card, format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_equal true, @response.parsed_body["stalled"]

    # Cards index (all)
    get cards_path
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    # Board show (stream) and column show
    get board_path(@board)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    get board_column_path(@board, columns(:writebook_in_progress))
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(column_card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(column_card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    # Public board stream, column, and card show
    get public_board_columns_stream_path(@board.publication.key)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    get public_board_column_path(@board.publication.key, columns(:writebook_in_progress))
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(column_card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(column_card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, @card)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "article##{dom_id(@card, :article)}.card--stalled"
    assert_select "##{dom_id(@card, :bubble)}:not([hidden])", /Stalled for\s*15\s*days/

Okay, here's my take on those thoughts, framed as my own:

**Debugging After a Test Hiccup**

Right, so that's interesting. It looks like `logout_and_sign_in_as` in the tests actually *did* its job a little too well. The `Session.delete_all` call means the fixture row for `sessions(:kevin)` was wiped out, which explains why the test was failing when it tried to access it. It was trying to load that particular session, and it wasn't there anymore. So, `Current.session` needed to be updated—probably, this would've been handled naturally by `with_current_user(:kevin)` or a similar approach.

And then there's that pesky Ruby script. Yikes, looks like a simple interpolation error got me. Using `#{dom_id}` in a string instead of a heredoc (`<<~'RUBY'`)? Rookie mistake! That explains why the DOM ID wasn't behaving as I anticipated.

Alright, both issues are identified. Let's get these fixed cleanly, and then run the *entire* test suite to make sure nothing else broke. This kind of interaction between fixtures and helper methods is pretty common, so it's a good learning opportunity to be more mindful of those side effects.

messages.content:
I have implemented burst detection, stalled card flagging across all card views, activity resets, and `indexed_by=stalled` filtering:

- **Burst detection & stalled state (`Card::Stallable`, `Card::Burst`)**:
  - Records a burst on a card when three or more user comments from at least two distinct people land within one third of the board's effective auto-close period (`auto_postpone_period / 3.0`), when someone is assigned to the card, or when a closed card is reopened.
  - Marks active cards that had a burst and have seen no activity (`last_active_at <= 2.weeks.ago`) for two weeks as stalled (`Card.stalled`, `card.stalled?`).
  - Resets stalled state whenever any activity occurs on the card (comments, edits to title/description/due date/image, assignments, triage/board moves, steps, tags, reactions, gilding, etc.).
- **Listing stalled cards (`indexed_by=stalled`)**:
  - Wired `Card.indexed_by("stalled")` to `Card.stalled`, added `"stalled"` to `Filter::Fields::INDEXES`, and added a `"Stalled cards"` shortcut in the navigation menu.
- **Displaying stalled cards everywhere**:
  - Updated card previews, card show pages, board streams/columns, public board/card views, Stimulus `bubble_controller.js` (`"Stalled for <N> days"`), `card_article_tag` (`card--stalled`), Turbo Stream updates, and JSON views (`"stalled"` boolean).

Let's submit the final output now.
